dict.string: Story of My Life shows your current location on the home screen so you always know where you are.
Story of My Life uses the microphone to listen to your voice so it can help you rediscover your memories.
Story of My Life uses speech recognition to understand what you say and respond with personalised memory stories.
Story of My Life can use the camera to capture new memory photos.
Story of My Life accesses your photo library to display and add memory photos.
Story of My Life saves captured photos to your photo library.
Story of My Life uses Apple Music to play familiar songs from your past, helping to trigger positive memories and feelings of comfort.
Story of My Life can use your Personal Voice so the AI companion sounds like you or a loved one.
